title: Atinuke Wole-Ilori
text: I am originally Nigerian and moved to Canada in December 2024. I have a BSc in Information Science and Media Studies. I am hoping on becoming a proficient data scientist at the end of the program.

title: My first weeks in MDS
text:
My first weeks in MDS have been really overwhelming in various aspects. I’ve met a handful of lovely peers and this is exciting. However, I have been exposed the the level of work I will have to do in the program and it has been interesting(… to say the least). I’m excited to face the remaining weeks.
